Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When describing why the problem matters, add a concrete result for the people, such as “很多人因为吃了有毒的植物，常常生病。”
2. At the moment Shen Nong decides to try the plants, add his determined thought or speech, such as “神农想：‘我一定要找出哪些植物能吃。’”
3. Give one plant a small sensory detail to make the testing scene more vivid, such as “这种植物闻起来很香，吃起来有一点儿甜。”

ideas.reason: It gives a concrete consequence that explains why Shen Nong wants to test the plants.
It adds fitting motivation and direct speech at the point when he begins his work.
It adds a simple sensory detail that fits Shen Nong tasting different plants.
